portrait.guidance: The standalone 800×800 headshot is color, not monochrome. A smooth dark-gray backdrop complements the banner while warm skin prevents the avatar from becoming visually flat. Hair starts at y≈53 (7%); head is centered near x=400; eyes around y=282 (35%); chin around y=562 (70%). Face/head width is about 350 px (44%); shoulders fill the lower third. The camera is near eye level, pose frontal, gaze direct, mouth closed with a very slight smile. Lighting is soft but directional from image-left/front, producing a darker image-right cheek and a warm dimensional face. The black shirt blends into the dark background at the edges. Retain enough midtone detail that a circular avatar does not become a dark disk.
